entries.german: Wok v. Rosenberg erneuert und vermehrt die von ihm seiner Stiftung zu Hohenfurt gemachten Schenkungen. Siegler: Wok. Zeugen: dominus Heinricus et Werenhardus fratres de Schowenberch, Werenhardus et Heinricus eiusdem tituli fratres minores ... (drei Zeilen unleserlich) ... Benata, Benysius, Budelaus, purchgravii de Rosenburch.
entries.english: Wok von Rosenberg renews and enlarges the gifts he had made to his foundation at Hohenfurt. Sealer: Wok. Witnesses: the lords Heinrich and Werenhard, brothers of Schowenberg; the younger brothers Werenhard and Heinrich of the same house; and, among others, Benata, Benisius, and Budelaus, burgraves of Rosenberg. Three lines are illegible.
